title: Zenith
description: A comprehensive, satisfying Minecraft modpack with shaders, smooth performance, immersive sounds, clean UI, and beautiful visuals.
body:

A Fabric 1.20.1 modpack focused on immersive exploration, improved world generation, enhanced combat, and Create-powered automation.

This pack overhauls Minecraft with stunning new structures, expanded biomes, atmospheric sounds, better animations, powerful weapons, and a wide range of Create addons for building advanced machines and factories.

Featuring mods like Create, BetterEnd, Better Dungeons, Simply Swords, Farmer’s Delight, and William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld, this modpack blends adventure, technology, and world enhancement into one polished experience.

Perfect for players who enjoy exploration, engineering, and a richer survival world with endless things to discover.
